files.content:
# Examples/WhatsApp keyboard panel

A full-width, short WhatsApp keyboard panel whose grid reflows its columns.

Install emoji-picker-react 5 or later, import './picker.css', then render <PickerExample className="wa-picker" />. Pass onEmojiClick to insert the chosen emoji into your app. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. This snippet is the picker only; the surrounding demo app chrome is not included.
